themes.switch: data-theme attribute on <html>, persisted in localStorage key pl-theme, applied by an inline script in app/layout.tsx before first paint; dark is the default and the fallback
themes.tailwindRemap: app/theme.css remaps --color-{slate,gray,zinc,neutral,stone} to the forest ladder, {emerald,green,teal,lime} to ok green, {amber,yellow,orange} to amber, {red,rose,pink,fuchsia} to coral, {blue,sky,cyan,indigo,violet,purple} to info blue; the light scale is inverted so legacy utilities keep meaning
themes.generation: theme.css is generated by a script outside the repo; regenerating needs the token table

display.purpose: Landing H1 only, Geist 650, one accent line in amber.

title.purpose: CTA band and large panel headings.

figure.purpose: All rupee amounts, percentages and counts, Geist Mono, tabular numerals.

figure-lg.purpose: 20-52px mono: stats, playground and gauge figures.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The one tinted shadow (--shadow) for lifted panels.

shadows.name: primary-button
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-brand) 22%, transparent), 0 10px 22px -14px var(--brand)
shadows.purpose: Primary button ring and tinted drop. The inset ring is a ledger-era remnant, recorded as built.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Entrances, button lift and arrow nudge.

motion.name: scroll-timeline
motion.value: animation-timeline: scroll(root block) for the progress bar; view() for reveals and step-line draw; guarded by @supports with a fallback
motion.purpose: Scroll effects with no scroll listeners.

motion.name: stat-counter
motion.value: motion/react animate() writing to DOM nodes

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: global prefers-reduced-motion override in app/ledger.css; landing css has its own block; theme.css disables smooth scroll

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single amber action; lifts 1px on hover, presses on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--brand, #dca94b); background: var(--brand, #dca94b); color: var(--on-brand, #1a1204); font-family: var(--font-display, 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-brand, #1a1204) 22%, transparent), 0 10px 22px -14px var(--brand, #dca94b); transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hi, #ebc374); border-color: var(--brand-hi, #ebc374); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #dca94b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: outlined, border turns amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--border3, #46645a); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #e8efea); font-family: var(--font-display, 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--brand, #dca94b); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand, #dca94b) 8%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #dca94b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: 14px container with hairline border; figures in mono.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #15211c); color: var(--text, #e8efea); border: 1px solid var(--border, #243630); border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--muted, #b3c2b9); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-fig { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500; font-size: 28px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Fully round delta or status pill using a status hue.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok, #5fc59a) 14%, transparent); color: var(--ok-ink, #86d6b0); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok, #5fc59a) 40%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
A dark green-black ground with one warm amber accent, the way a lamp reads in a wood at dusk. The system is calm, dense with real numbers, and quiet everywhere except the one place the eye should go. Dark is the default theme; a light "stone" theme is equally first-class and swaps every semantic token, not a filter. The theme is saved as pl-theme in localStorage and applied by an inline script in app/layout.tsx before first paint.

The landing and login are built from the product's own output: the hero proof is a real estimate-engine result, not a drawn imitation. Layout is left-aligned and asymmetric, motion is CSS-first, and decoration is withheld. The system replaced an earlier ledger-paper identity; remnants of it survive only inside the tool.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (amber) across the whole page, locked in both themes.
Hairline borders and one tinted shadow; no layered glow.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for every figure.
Tokens are semantic CSS custom properties in app/theme.css; Tailwind palette scales are remapped to them so the tool follows the theme.
Page theme lock: sections never invert against the page theme.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only chromatic accent on landing, login and chrome. Status hues carry meaning (covered, caution, denied, note) and are never used as decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Lock Rule
rules.body: The whole page follows the active theme. No section is inverted to the opposite theme for contrast; the CTA band is in-theme.

rules.name: The Remap Rule
rules.body: Tailwind slate, gray, zinc, neutral, stone map to the forest ladder; emerald, green, teal, lime to ok green; amber, yellow, orange to amber; red, rose, pink, fuchsia to coral; blue, cyan, sky, indigo, violet, purple to info blue. The light scales are inverted so legacy utilities keep their meaning. Do not hard-code Tailwind hex for new work; use the semantic variables.

rules.name: The Mono Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure is Geist Mono with tabular numerals, in prose rows, tables, gauges and counters.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: One tinted --shadow per theme. No stacked glows, no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do use the semantic variables (--bg, --card, --text, --brand, --ok, --warn, --deny, --info) so both themes work.
Do set every figure in Geist Mono with tabular numerals.
Do show real engine output as product proof.
Do use animation-timeline guarded by @supports, and IntersectionObserver for nav state.
Do keep landing and login copy free of em-dashes.
donts: Don't add a second accent or use status hues decoratively.
Don't invert a section against the page theme.
Don't build fake product UI out of divs where real output can be rendered.
Don't add eyebrows, section numerals, decorative dots, marquees or scroll cues.
carried: Tool interior (/app, components/policy/*) keeps ledger-era chrome: statement block with margin rules, stamp-style badges, rotated .pl-stamp, Lucide icons.
Primary button 2px inset stamp ring is a ledger-era remnant.
Some em and en dashes remain in tool strings.
theme.css is generated by a script outside the repo; regenerating needs the token table.
Type ramp is wide (about 20 distinct sizes) and radius scale has 12 steps; documented as shipped, could be consolidated later.
